notes_for_us: Every option in this build traces to something the user said, so preset_derived is empty even though I took the Life preset whole. That is what the labelling rule is for, but it means a preset that fits perfectly looks like it contributed nothing.

A claimable crew turf - territory a group owns, sized in tiers, gated by purchase - has no option. I built it from a purchase gate plus zoned districts, which gets the walls and the separation but not the ownership or the tiering.

Roleplay has no row for a shop that is a shop, only building-interior for enterable buildings generally. A prompt naming five specific venues gets one option repeated five times in its text, so nothing downstream can tell the gun shop from the clothing shop.
